unique_publications_2025.label: Unique publications
unique_publications_2025.definition: Journal articles and preprints without an associated journal article, published by grantees or authors at the foundation.

compliance_2025.label: Policy compliance
compliance_2025.definition: The percentage of publications covered by the foundation’s Open Access policy that are compliant with it.

preprints_2025.label: Preprints
preprints_2025.definition: Preprints published by grantees or authors at the foundation.

das_2025.label: Data availability statements
das_2025.definition: The percentage of journal articles we’ve analysed that have a data availability statement.
